s1.syndrome_frame: Chronic multisystem disorder with skin manifestations and endocrine abnormalities
salient_findings: Numerous asymptomatic reddish-brownish papules, nodules, and plaques over the whole body
Central diabetes insipidus, growth retardation, and hypothyroidism
key_facts: 7-year medical history of skin lesions
Skin lesions began on bilateral eyelid margins and extended to trunk and extremities
Patient has central diabetes insipidus
Patient has growth retardation
Patient has hypothyroidism
Skin biopsy showed dense granulomatous infiltrate in the upper dermis
Immunohistochemical results were negative for CD1a and S-100, positive for CD68

Skin lesions are present on periocular areas, perioral areas, neck, shoulder, axillary folds, cubital fossa, wrists, palms, umbilical region, lateral abdomen, inguinal area, anogenital area, popliteal fossa, and ankles

shortlist.label: Erdheim-Chester Disease
shortlist.why_kept: Matches chronic multisystem disorder with skin manifestations and endocrine abnormalities, and specific histiocytic infiltrate pattern

shortlist.label: Langerhans Cell Histiocytosis
shortlist.why_kept: Consistent with skin lesions, diabetes insipidus, and growth retardation, despite negative CD1a and S-100

shortlist.label: Necrobiotic Xanthogranuloma
shortlist.why_kept: Characterized by granulomatous skin lesions and potential endocrine abnormalities

shortlist.label: Adult-Onset Multisystem Histocytosis
shortlist.why_kept: Involves multiple systems, including skin and endocrine, with histiocytic infiltration

shortlist.label: Multifocal Eosinophilic Granuloma
shortlist.why_kept: Presents with skin lesions and potential endocrine involvement, although less common

shortlist.label: Sarcoidosis
shortlist.why_kept: Can manifest with skin lesions and endocrine abnormalities, although histology does not strongly support

shortlist.label: Multicentric Reticulohistiocytosis
shortlist.why_kept: Involves skin and potentially other systems, with histiocytic infiltration, but less typical endocrine findings

shortlist.label: Hand-Schuller-Christian Disease
shortlist.why_kept: Presents with skin lesions, diabetes insipidus, and exophthalmos, although some features do not perfectly align
